text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately not... Since I was off, I set
out to
enjoy the wind to the fullest, only
to be greeted
by so still a day.
choice_data_list: もしかしてあまり眠れなかった？
choice_data_list_en: Were you not able to sleep much?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I waited and waited for the wind to
blow, but
before I knew it, night had
fallen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Yamanin Zephyr is
sleep-deprived
after struggling to make
the most of her day off.
